title: From Neurons to Semantics: Evaluating Cross-Linguistic Alignment Capabilities of Large Language Models via Neurons Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating centralization bias (English-centric representation space) and performance disparities between high-resource (head) and low-resource (long-tail) languages using cross-lingual parallel sentence retrieval tasks and comparing alignment scores derived from neuron activation states (NeuronXA).
